name: Jinzi Ham Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jinzi Ham Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of ham and meat products in China and internationally. The company offers Parma, golden, Chinese, European fermented, and other ham products; sausages, braised meat, bacon, grilled sausage, XO Sauce, and other pure meat products; prepared meat products, including Ham and duck pot, ham stewed chicken, ham stewed pigeon, honey sauce fire square, golden and silver pig's trotter, pickled pork with preserved vegetables, crispy meat, Dongpo Meat, twice-cooked pork, etc.; chilled and cut meat; and ham mooncakes, as well as ham ice cream and biscuits. The company primarily serves fresh food e-commerce, social e-commerce…
